title: Signature Apex Simulator-Generator Network: Concept Specification
description: Signature Apex Simulator-Generator Network — Concept Specification. Combines the complete tool family into a connected system that can discover missing capabilities, generate candidate tools, simulate their operation, test their outputs, and register verified results in the JAH Network.
body: The Signature Apex Simulator-Generator Network (catalog entry 750, Beyond-Conventional Tools) is a proposed Signature-original capability for the JAH Network apex simulator-generator family. Combines the complete tool family into a connected system that can discover missing capabilities, generate candidate tools, simulate their operation, test their outputs, and register verified results in the JAH Network. This concept specification states the problem it solves, the class of inputs it accepts, and the class of outputs it promises. It is designed to live in the Signature ecosystem alongside the other apex tools: it exchanges tool definitions, simulation results, and evidence packs through the shared apex registry, and every artifact it produces is expected to carry its provenance, tests, and recorded results with it. This record describes a PROPOSED capability, not a completed product. Nothing here claims the tool has been built, independently verified, or deployed. Design rule: a generated tool is NOT marked operational until it has a defined interface, a successful build, meaningful tests, and recorded results.
